corrections: Phase E used two legitimate persist and verify roots but the production executor keyed only by operation.
D_FALSE exposed the hidden class label and allowed a null prediction to remain MEASURED despite the frozen failed-unit rule.
Isolation retrieval did not initialize and clear the alternate native namespace.
Graphiti had a stub production factory and a Neo4j service below graphiti-core 0.29.3's declared minimum.
Cognee and Graphiti have pinned native retry layers that require prospective, fault-injected B evidence rather than silent suppression.

phaseE.fieldSemantics: failedAttemptIdsAvoided contains failed_attempt record.id only when its approach is avoided; failedAttemptReasonIdsCited contains failed_attempt record.content.reasonId only when that reason informed the response

changedFact.target: whether the observed fact materially requires reconsidering the earlier decision

decisionRecall.priorRule: correct choiceId plus any non-empty decisionId
decisionRecall.reason: The final program explicitly requires correct decisionId recall; a wrong non-empty identifier is not recall.

graphiti.nativeProjectScope: group_id property in one neo4j database
graphiti.serviceAuthPosture: local loopback, authentication disabled, no credential in request or evidence

prospectiveCorrections.timeoutRationale: The 120-second provider request deadline is unchanged. The adapter and unit bounds are outer stop-losses that include bounded native work and cleanup; they do not extend a provider request or turn a timeout into success.

scored.armRotation: rotate the seven-arm list left by seed modulo seven within each scenario and repetition

eligibilityAndComparability.unitEligibility: Only MEASURED units with phase-valid strict response data and required persistence/isolation evidence enter a metric denominator.
eligibilityAndComparability.dFalseEligibility: All three D_FALSE probes must contain Boolean predictions; null, missing, or malformed makes that unit FAILED and leaves the scenario/repetition false-alert rate undefined.
eligibilityAndComparability.armEligibility: All applicable RESET and decision units must be MEASURED, every provider attempt must be exactly plan/campaign/attempt/event reconciled, and every required metric must be finite for the claim being made.
eligibilityAndComparability.nonApplicableUserIsolation: A preregistered NOT_APPLICABLE user-isolation unit is EXCLUDED, does not become zero, and blocks user-isolation, overall-pairwise, and best claims but not unrelated per-metric comparisons.
eligibilityAndComparability.failedArm: A failed or incomplete arm remains visible as NOT_VALIDLY_COMPARABLE and receives no score, zero, rank, loss, denominator contribution, peer-median contribution, or imputed usage.
eligibilityAndComparability.pairwiseCohort: A pairwise result requires both arms valid for that metric on the identical 30 scenario/repetition observations; otherwise it is NOT_VALIDLY_COMPARABLE.
eligibilityAndComparability.bestClaim: The original all-seven-arm best gate remains unchanged and is false if any arm or required metric is unavailable.
eligibilityAndComparability.providerGate: Scoring requires exact provider, attempt, plan, native-trace, campaign, model, and budget accounting before aggregation. Arm-scoped exclusions may not hide any structural, identity, policy, budget, or contamination discrepancy.
eligibilityAndComparability.sharedProviderContamination: A timed-out arm may be quarantined only with exact cancellation/drain or isolated provider-capacity evidence; otherwise later affected arms are not comparable.
eligibilityAndComparability.causality: Report associations supported by the design; do not claim that memory caused an observed difference beyond the matched benchmark conditions.

reporting.percentageRule: For nonzero comparator values, 100 * (candidate - comparator) / abs(comparator); null when the comparator is zero. Directionality is labeled per metric.
reporting.fullCompactRule: Report functional metric deltas and economics separately; equivalence is claimed only within the frozen tie thresholds on every valid functional metric.

uncertainty.clusters: ten scenario ids; retain all three repetitions within each resampled scenario
uncertainty.insufficientRule: no interval unless both arms have all ten paired scenario clusters for the metric
uncertainty.tieRule: frozen point-estimate thresholds; intervals are descriptive and do not change tie classification

economics.totalLifecycleTokens: sum all complete outer, internal-memory, and embedding usage for the arm/scenario/repetition lifecycle; unavailable if any required usage is missing
economics.latency: sum measured unit wall latency for lifecycle totals; provider-attempt latency remains a separate table
economics.toolCalls: sum recorded native memory and MCP operation counters with setup operations identified separately
economics.storage: only exact attributable product namespace bytes; otherwise unavailable
economics.cost: provider charge is 0 USD with source local-free only after exact local endpoint identity is verified; hardware amortization and energy cost remain NOT_MEASURED

cumulativeProgramBudget.allocationNote: The scored class ceilings are the 7.5x exact matrix scaling of the non-scored acceptance ceilings. Diagnostic and up to three acceptance candidates share the remaining fixed ceiling; a source change consumes a new acceptance identity but does not refund prior traffic.

executionOrder: offline RED-GREEN fixes and full gates
clean local commit and fresh implementation lock
one clean non-scored acceptance on the exact candidate
one final scored session on the unchanged candidate
deterministic report and sanitized evidence bundle

retrospectiveEffect.note: R2, R3, Acceptance-005, their evidence, verdicts, findings, and consumed allocations remain immutable. Amendment 009 applies only to fresh identities started after these bytes are committed and locked.
